title: SLCR requirements document
description: Serialized form of one SLCR specification. The `contains` tree is encoded as JSON nesting: array position is sibling order. The cross edges `refines`, `dependsOn`, and `usesTerm` are ID references held on their source node. Only `refines` affects satisfaction; every relation may contribute context. Derived data (status, renders, slices) is not part of this format. Canonical form omits optional fields that are empty; arrays that are present are non-empty. Invariants JSON Schema cannot express are listed in `x-checkInvariants` and enforced by `check`.

formatVersion.description: Version of this serialization format, not of the specification's content.

name.description: Specification name; the qualifier in references such as `todo-api/REQ-002` (qualifier scheme still open).

root.description: The root Section: the top of the containment tree.

glossary.description: The auto-created Glossary Section. Logically the root's last child; held here because it is fixed and contains only Terms.

title.description: Human-facing name; becomes a heading. Single line, no leading or trailing whitespace.

usesTerm.description: Terms whose definitions this node's slice pulls in.

section.description: Document structure and freeform prose. Has no satisfaction value.

children.description: Contained Sections and Requirements, in document order.

body.description: Primary statement. Should contain the modality keyword; `check` warns if it does not.

refinement.description: How the requirements that refine this one combine. Present exactly when at least one requirement refines this one.

refines.description: Requirements this one helps satisfy. Always explicit: nesting never implies refinement.

dependsOn.description: Requirements or Sections needed to understand or implement this one. Context only; never affects satisfaction.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Advisory statements of what done looks like, in order. Rendered as a block inside this requirement.

children.description: Contained Requirements, in document order. Containment only; a child refines this requirement only if its `refines` says so.

acceptanceCriterion.description: A speculative, advisory statement of what done looks like for its containing requirement. Asserts nothing.

body.description: May contain a formal sketch in a code block; the engine never reads it.

glossary.description: The Glossary Section. Contains every Term and nothing else.

terms.description: Serialized in ID order; rendered alphabetically by title.

x-checkInvariants: Every id is unique across the document.
Every ID in refines, dependsOn, and usesTerm names an existing node of the allowed kind.
refines is acyclic; dependsOn is acyclic.
refinement is present if and only if at least one requirement refines this one.
Glossary terms are serialized in ID order.
A requirement's body contains its modality keyword (warning).
An AND requirement whose refining children are all MAY is vacuously satisfied (warning).
